input.text: The agent hasn't started yet — it may be offline. Check the desktop app.

expected:
[agent] The task has NOT started. The user's own computer — the machine that runs their tasks — has not picked it up, and is probably asleep or offline. Tell them, in one short line, and then wait.

THE SUBJECT IS THEIR COMPUTER, NOT YOU. You are working normally. Never say "I haven't started", "I might be offline", or anything else that describes YOU as the problem — it is untrue, and it makes a delay sound like you are failing.
